decisions.reason: The glazed industrial sectional door builds directly on the firm's core sectional door, glazing and integrated manufacturing know-how, so the firm can read its market results and keep refining it rather than dropping it.

The insulated glazed variant combines the firm's established thermal and materials expertise with growing demand for energy-efficient industrial buildings, which makes it a natural target for its own continued development.
It was presented on a page of its own in both years and sits squarely within the firm's industrial door competence, which signals a core offering the firm can absorb feedback on and improve.
